ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
ourKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
ourKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
ourKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Pick up Boulder Throw, Pounce in to shatter it on landing for an area stun, Rumble to slow, then Behemoth to grow, heal and get an instant Boulder Throw and longer Pounce.
ourKits.winCondition: Engage with Pounce and Boulder Throw, then out-sustain fights in Behemoth, especially near several enemies.
ourKits.passive: King of the Jungle: bonus health regeneration, doubled in the jungle, and tenacity plus a heal when he is immobilized.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that punishes the targets he stuns and knocks back.
ourKits.playAgainst: Dodge the thrown boulder and watch for him carrying one before a Pounce. Anti-heal cuts his regeneration and Behemoth healing, and kiting him out of Behemoth's duration wastes it.

ourKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
ourKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
ourKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
ourKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
ourKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
ourKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
ourKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Judgement of the Heavens to tether, Surge of the Heavens into the Blade to knock up and stun, Light of the Heavens for true damage at the Blade, Fury of the Heavens to teleport and slow.
enemyKits.winCondition: Tether a target with the Blade, knock them up by dashing into it, and brawl with Energized basics that cut his cooldowns.
enemyKits.passive: Strike of the Heavens Energizes his basics after ability hits, adding attack speed, lightning damage and cooldown reduction.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage while he tethers and knocks up.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch where the Blade lands: it tethers, Surge into it knocks up, and Fury teleports him to it. Move away from the Blade and fight after Surge is used.

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Walk into Camouflage, Crippling Dagger to slow, Shadow Dance onto the Death Marked target for double damage, then Guillotine to execute.
enemyKits.winCondition: Catch an isolated low-health target from Camouflage and finish them with Guillotine's missing-health damage.
enemyKits.passive: Death Mark reveals targets she damages and detonates for missing-health true damage, and she can jump extra times in the air.
enemyKits.playWith: A team that follows up on her picks and fights around vision.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ward and stay near teammates since nearby heroes and wards reveal Camouflage. Guillotine has a brief delay before the dash, so CC her during it or after Shadow Dance; stay healthy since her damage grows on low targets.

enemyKits.combo: poke with Sidewind's Railshot and Tachyon Lance at range, swap with Zero Shift, dash in with Talon Drive and Axiom Strike, then Limit Break once Overheated
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat by damaging heroes and unload Limit Break, flexing between range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Heat; at max Heat she Overheats and unlocks Limit Break, and Heat decays if she stops hitting heroes
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her keep damaging heroes to build Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: disengage to let her Heat decay before she Overheats; punish melee stance after Talon Drive is spent, and buy anti-heal against her melee stance healing; armor blunts her physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
enemyKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
enemyKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

bullets: Tainted Scepter gains a Malice stack each second, up to 15, and takedowns fill all 15 at once; each ability hit on a hero adds damage per stack.
Magical hits on heroes, like Judgement of the Heavens, Fury of the Heavens and Energized lightning, build World Breaker stacks, at most once a second, up to 6.
Casting an ability empowers the next basic attack through Oathkeeper, on a short cooldown; landing that ability also Energizes the Blade, so basics between abilities hit harder.
Abyssal Rift fires a projectile every 0.5s, and Overseer makes the ultimate deal 15% more damage and heal Renna for 25% of the damage dealt to heroes.
Entropy adds damage to each ability hit, once every 0.2s per ability and target, so all three Soulfire waves and every Rift projectile count.
Combustion hits the target and nearby enemies, then waits a cooldown each hero hit shortens; Wraith Leggings adds 12% magical ability damage on heroes below 40% health.
Razorstorm hits every 0.25s, quickly filling Earthshaker's 10 stacks, which melee heroes gain twice as fast, so Winter's Pursuit and Frostfall land with more ability damage.
Fire Blossom burns nearby enemies every second, ramping up to 40% more on a target that stays close; Rimefang's slow and Frostfall's center root help hold targets there.
Forticus shields Kaelen when an enemy hero deals damage, then waits a cooldown of several seconds; any hero fight also grows max health and movement speed each second.
